script: Don't say goodnight. Say something that won't let her sleep. Say this: When you lay your head down tonight, try not to remember how I make you feel. Because if you do, she won't fall asleep for hours. Curiosity hates a question left unanswered, so she keeps wondering. That's when you stop being a message and become a feeling. The smart man leaves a mark.
